items.title: Baby Saved After Racing Heartbeat Detected by Family Doberman
items.summary: A baby’s life was likely saved after his racing heartbeat was detected by the family dog—that wouldn’t stop crying. Kim Reynolds was confounded by her doberman’s unusual “needy” behavior around six-month-old Alexander.

items.title: Adventurer Finally Hugs Mom After 28-Year Walk Around the World From Home in UK
items.summary: A British adventurer who has walked around the world on a 28-year hike has finally reunited with his tearful mother.

items.title: Your Positive Weekly Horoscope: ‘Free Will Astrology’ by Rob Brezsny
items.summary: Our partner Rob Brezsny, whose latest book is Enlightenment for Rebels: Celebrating Our Wild and Sacred Earthly Selves, provides his weekly wisdom to enlighten our thinking and motivate our mood.
